questions.explain: AI absorbs the repetitive and pattern-matchable work while amplifying judgment, accountability, and systems thinking; DBAs who own outcomes become more essential, while checklist executors are exposed.
options: The DBA role will disappear entirely by 2030
AI automates repetitive, pattern-matchable work while making judgment, accountability, and systems thinking more valuable
DBAs will only write Python and never touch SQL Server again
Certifications will become the only thing that matters
questions.q: What is the chapter's central claim about how AI changes the DBA role?

questions.explain: The five competencies are Python for data operations, operator-level ML literacy, cloud data platform fluency, AI systems governance, and communication/technical writing — all built on top of SQL Server fundamentals.
options: Kubernetes, Go, Rust, Terraform, and React
Python for data ops, ML literacy, cloud fluency, AI governance, and technical writing
Only T-SQL and PowerShell, taken to expert level
Project management, budgeting, hiring, and public speaking
questions.q: Which five new competencies does the chapter say the 2030 DBA must build on top of SQL Server fundamentals?

questions.explain: Track B (Data Platform & AI Engineering) owns feature stores, vector search, model serving, and MLOps pipelines — the infrastructure the organization's AI runs on, per Chapter 38.
options: Data Platform & AI Engineering — owning feature stores, vector search, model serving, and MLOps pipelines
Database backup administration
Help-desk support for BI tools
Manual ETL development with SSIS only
questions.q: A DBA who most enjoyed building the Chapter 38 platform (feature stores, vector search, model serving) belongs on which specialization track?

questions.explain: The 2027 milestone is promoting a shadow-mode system through the gating tiers to autonomous Tier 1 execution, with the explainability log and weekly close-call reviews running.
options: Earning three cloud certifications
Promoting a shadow-mode AI system to autonomous Tier 1 execution with explainability logging and close-call reviews
Migrating every database to the cloud
Writing a book
questions.q: What is the defining 2027 milestone in the year-by-year roadmap?

questions.explain: Proof of work — an open-source automation repo, writing about failures, teaching — beats proof of study, because hiring managers for AI-adjacent roles ask candidates to show something they built.
options: Collecting as many certifications as possible
Building public proof of work: open-source automation, writing about failures, and teaching
Avoiding any public visibility to protect trade secrets
Specializing in a single SQL Server version
questions.q: Why does the chapter argue that portfolio proof beats credentials for AI-era database careers?

title: The 2030 DBA: Career Roadmap in the AI Era
